Funny, witty, experimental, edgy, emotional, and fun. Chews Happiness is dedicated to producing content that entertains, informs, and shares the happiness of pets, pet parents, and the planet.

We create artisanal, unique, socially responsible pet products that do good for you, your pet, and the planet™. Our first products come from Bhutan, the founder of Gross National Happiness and a unique country leading the way to Gross National Happiness and committed to clean air & water, organic farming, and conservation.

By mid-2019, we will commercialize an amazing line of artisanal cat and dog treats, which are made high up in the Himalayas in a U.S. FDA registered facility in Bhutan.

Let your doggie absorb the Happiness Vibes from this special place!
